# E0121: a field every lineage has is not concrete

A lineage's name and schemas are concrete: the name is a string literal, not a
constraint on one. Here the name is left as `string`, so there is no name.

## Example

`lineage.cue`:

```cue
name: string
schemas: {
	"0": {
		"0": {
			schema: {
				a: string
			}
		}
	}
}
```

thema reports:

```
error[E0121]: name is not concrete
 --> lineage.cue:1:1
  |
1 | name: string
  | ^^^^
  |
```
